# QPLIB regression fixtures

`QPLIB_0018.qplib` was downloaded unchanged on 2026-09-11 from
<https://qplib.zib.de/qplib/QPLIB_0018.qplib>. QPLIB is licensed under
[CC-BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
Attribution: Furini et al., *QPLIB: a library of quadratic programming
instances*, Mathematical Programming Computation,
[DOI: 10.1007/s12532-018-0147-4](https://doi.org/10.1007/s12532-018-0147-4).
Instance donor: Andrea Scozzari.

The published solution and objective value used in the tests come from
<https://qplib.zib.de/sol/QPLIB_0018.sol>. The state is specified directly in
the tests and does not require solution-file parsing support.

`quadratic_scaling.qplib` is a synthetic two-variable problem covering
diagonal, cross, linear, and constant terms and both constraint-bound directions.
